items.text: SpaceX stock climbs to highest since June, returning Musk to trillionaire status
items.summary_cn: 媒体报道称SpaceX股价升至去年6月以来最高水平，并推动Musk财富重新达到万亿美元级别。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Musk says he will rename SpaceXAI to SpaceXSI
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Musk表示将把SpaceXAI更名为SpaceXSI，涉及航天与人工智能业务的整合或品牌调整，但相关公司未上市。

items.text: Gridlock looms on congressional stock trade ban as parties clash over divestment

items.author: Trump
items.text: If Republicans win the House of Representatives and the Senate in the 2026 Midterm Elections, I’m going to give all Adult Citizens in the United States of America, $5,000. Thank you for your attention to this matter, and I look forward to signing those checks! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: 特朗普表示若共和党在2026年中期选举中赢得国会，将向美国成年公民发放5000美元，潜在影响财政预期和市场情绪。
